newsitem.title: CONGO: Shells fired near centre of Congo capital - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Shells fired near centre of Congo capital - witnesses.

text.p: Shells were fired near the centre of the Congo capital Brazzaville on Monday, where fighting has erupted between a political militia and forces loyal to President Pascal Lissouba, witnesses said.
"There have been loud explosions coming from some parts of the city centre, it is not possible to tell who is firing at whom," said Reuters correspondent Helen Vesperini near the city centre.
She said French troops were evacuating their citizens living in the area, and that bullets had been fired into the building where she was living.
Fighting erupted on Thursday after soldiers surrounded the house of ex-president Denis Sassou Nguesso, whose militia responded by attacking loyalist troops.
In the Bacongo district, which has been relatively untouched by the fighting as it is the fiefdom of a militia which has so far been neutral, witnesses said a shell had landed killing one person.
